kind: Normalized summary transcribed from completed GitHub Actions logs; original detailed reports and source hashes are in the run logs
scope: Actual pinned provider implementations and cryptographic verifiers instantiated locally, public test VRF scalar 1, recorded drand signatures, artificial clock, synthetic native funds and fixture ticket token. Not a public oracle request, native Arc or Nitro execution test, full application or audit.

retainedFailure.cause: Test harness expected ethers CALL_EXCEPTION but Hardhat reverted eth_sendTransaction surfaced UNKNOWN_ERROR containing the EVM revert
retainedFailure.correction: Mine local reverted sends with throwOnTransactionFailures false; continue requiring CALL_EXCEPTION and assert status 0 on receipt or estimateGas action. No changes to draw/provider contracts or scenario assertions. Deploy linked library with constructor-only ABI to avoid library enum ABI warning.

limitations: Known public VRF scalar and historical public beacon data establish code-path verification, not unpredictable public randomness or live oracle liveness
Generic local Hardhat native funds and an explicit ArbSys shim are not full Arc or Robinhood chain simulation
Local compiled runtime fingerprints are not claimed equal to production bytecode; addresses, keys, constructor parameters and metadata differ
Injected callback/refund failures use a separate RecoveryProbe, not altered main draw code
Service-fee refunds are not participant ticket refunds; fixture ticket tokens remain locked
Announced prize is not escrow, proof of reserve funding or an executed staking payout
Same-word retry does not charge another service fee but still requires transaction gas
Fixture prices, prize amounts, gas limits and fees are not approved production economics
Previous fork and historical-proof suites were not rerun; this is not a complete end-to-end payment-to-stake application
nextScopedImplementation: Local-only capped operating-fee budget/refund-credit adapter, then per-chain/token/round funding ledger. Bind payer and refund destination explicitly; conserve funds and prohibit use of participant or arcade liabilities. No production default prices or percentages.
